title: access_log
description: Changes access logging for the requests in its scope (spec §9.4, §12.2). The access log never includes header values, so there is nothing to redact.

enabled.description: When false, requests in this scope are not logged.

sample_rate.description: The share of requests logged, from 0 to 1.

custom_fields.description: Field name to a template (spec §9.5). Written as one JSON object in the line's custom field.
